description: Build Preview A: the AWS Config / Security Hub-style Cloudscape dashboard app, the first working preview that proves the preview mechanism and consumes the shared @agentcore2/contracts seam. It uses ONLY the shared contract + MockBackendAdapter (no copied domain logic), demonstrating that new experiments attach to the seam. Little or no AI. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Create apps/preview-a as a Vite + React + TypeScript app (@agentcore2/preview-a): package.json with dev (`vite`), build (`tsc -b && vite build` or `vite build`), preview, test (`vitest run`) scripts; depend on @agentcore2/contracts (workspace:*), react, react-dom, @cloudscape-design/components, @cloudscape-design/global-styles, and Vite/React plugin + vitest devDeps. Add tsconfig.json extending base, vite.config.ts, and index.html.
Wire the app to obtain a BackendAdapter from the shared package (instantiate MockBackendAdapter). Centralize this in apps/preview-a/src/backend.ts so swapping the adapter later touches one file only.

Implement a LabModeBadge React component that reads adapter.mode() and renders a visible MOCK / RECORDED / LIVE LAB badge (Cloudscape Badge/Flashbar style) prominently in the app header. At M1 it shows MOCK.

Build the findings dashboard page using Cloudscape: AppLayout + top navigation header (with LabModeBadge), a Cloudscape Table listing findings from adapter.listFindings with columns (severity, compliance status, title, service, resource, region, last observed), server-style pagination wired to the adapter's Paginated result, and column sorting.

Add filtering controls (Cloudscape PropertyFilter or Select group) for compliance status, severity, resource type/service, and free-text search, all driven through the adapter's FindingQuery so filtering thousands of mock findings stays responsive.

Implement a finding detail view (Cloudscape SplitPanel or a detail page/drawer) showing full finding fields, the proposed remediation from adapter.getRemediationForFinding/previewFix, and Preview Fix / Remediate action buttons. Remediate opens an approval confirmation (Approve Once / Reject) and calls adapter.requestRemediation; show the resulting ExecutionState and executionId. All mock.

Implement an evidence timeline component that renders adapter.getEvidenceTimeline(findingId) as an ordered Cloudscape timeline/list, clearly showing the DETECTED -> ... -> PROVIDER_READBACK -> CONFIG_CONVERGENCE -> VERIFIED progression after a mock remediation.
Import @cloudscape-design/global-styles in the app entry so Cloudscape theming renders correctly. Ensure the app builds and runs with zero AWS credentials.

Add a small Vitest + React Testing Library smoke test in apps/preview-a: renders the dashboard with the MockBackendAdapter, asserts the MOCK badge is visible and that findings rows render; and a test that clicking Remediate with Approve produces an execution with an executionId and the evidence timeline gains a CONFIG_CONVERGENCE event. Configure vitest jsdom environment.
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm --filter @agentcore2/preview-a dev` starts a local Vite server serving the dashboard without AWS credentials.
The dashboard shows a findings table, working compliance/severity/resource filters, finding detail, mock Preview Fix / Remediate (Approve Once / Reject) actions, and an evidence timeline.
A visible MOCK badge is present in the UI.
The app imports domain types and the adapter from @agentcore2/contracts and does not redefine or copy them.
`pnpm --filter @agentcore2/preview-a test` passes the smoke and remediation-flow tests.
verification: Run `pnpm --filter @agentcore2/preview-a test` and confirm all tests pass.
Run `pnpm --filter @agentcore2/preview-a dev` (briefly, background) and confirm the dev server starts and serves without error.
findings:
App: apps/preview-a, package name @agentcore2/preview-a (private, type: module, ESM). Vite 5 + React 18 + TypeScript 5.9 + AWS Cloudscape (@cloudscape-design/components ^3, @cloudscape-design/global-styles ^1). Depends on the shared seam via "@agentcore2/contracts": "workspace:*"; imports domain types and MockBackendAdapter only (nothing copied/redefined).

Exact commands (run from repo root):
- Build:  pnpm --filter @agentcore2/preview-a build   (runs `tsc -b && vite build`; outputs to apps/preview-a/dist, gitignored)
- Test:   pnpm --filter @agentcore2/preview-a test    (runs `vitest run`; 2 tests: MOCK-badge+rows smoke test, and Approve->executionId + CONFIG_CONVERGENCE remediation-flow test)
- Dev:    pnpm --filter @agentcore2/preview-a dev      (Vite dev server on http://localhost:5173, confirmed HTTP 200, no AWS credentials)
- Preview:pnpm --filter @agentcore2/preview-a preview  (serves built dist)
Repo-wide `pnpm -r build` / `pnpm -r test` also cover this app.

Adapter seam is centralized in ONE file: apps/preview-a/src/backend.ts (getBackend() constructs the process-wide MockBackendAdapter once). Swapping to a real adapter later touches only this file. main.tsx passes the adapter into <App adapter=...>; every component consumes the BackendAdapter interface, never a concrete class.

LabModeBadge: apps/preview-a/src/components/LabModeBadge.tsx reads adapter.mode() and renders a Cloudscape Badge (MOCK=blue, RECORDED=green, LIVE LAB=red). Shown prominently in the page header (data-testid="lab-mode-badge"); at M1 it shows MOCK.

UI layout: Cloudscape AppLayout + ContentLayout. FindingsTable (columns: severity, compliance, title, service, resource, region, last observed) with filters (compliance/severity/service Selects + resource-type Input + free-text search Input) and pagination all driven through the adapter's FindingQuery/Paginated result; column sorting applied to the current page. Selecting a row opens a SplitPanel FindingDetail with full fields, proposed remediation (getRemediationForFinding/previewFix), Preview Fix + Remediate buttons; Remediate opens an Approve Once / Reject modal calling requestRemediation; the resulting ExecutionState + executionId is shown in an Alert, and EvidenceTimeline re-renders the DETECTED->...->PROVIDER_READBACK->CONFIG_CONVERGENCE->VERIFIED chain.

Testing: Vitest 2.1.9 with jsdom environment (config in vite.config.ts test block), globals enabled, setup file apps/preview-a/vitest.setup.ts imports @testing-library/jest-dom/vitest. Tests use @testing-library/react + user-event and a small deterministic dataset via generateDataset({size:40, seed:1}) for speed. Tests live in apps/preview-a/src/__tests__/.

Environment: `pnpm install` at repo root succeeded with NO ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS (existing onlyBuiltDependencies:[esbuild] + root .npmrc verify-deps-before-run=false covered the new Vite/esbuild deps; no extra pnpm rebuild needed). dist/, node_modules/, *.tsbuildinfo are gitignored. Vite emits a >500kB chunk-size warning (Cloudscape bundle) — cosmetic, build still succeeds; not addressed at M1.

REVIEW FIX (2026-09-30-143740-review.md, Issue #3 / M1): post-execution UI lockout in FindingDetail.tsx. The Remediate button is now disabled once an execution exists for the finding (disabled={busy || remediation === null || execution !== null}) and relabels to "Remediation recorded", so the UI can no longer trigger the (now idempotent) replay. The App.test.tsx approve-flow test asserts the button is disabled and relabeled after a SUCCEEDED result. preview-a tests still pass (2).
